title: New Jets CB Nahshon Wright leads all players in 2026 performance-based pay

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: New Jets CB Nahshon Wright leads all players in 2026 performance-based pay
sources.description: Cornerback Nahshon Wright's play with the Bears during the 2025 season landed him a contract with the Jets and it earned him the most performance-based pay in the league for last year as well.
